Description.English: Adds 12 Gracchus specialists, +50t storage and doubled loading ramps for the Granary and all warehouse tiers, and two auto-granted chests. Scipio boosts all residences, Gaius, Lucius, and Agrippa supply each region's workforces, Marcellus upgrades army recruitment and strength, Fulvia speeds up warehouses and trading posts, and Latinus, Britannicus, and Aegyptius give an island every fertility of their region.
